soundness_flags.label: ass:conditional-parallel-trends and thm:full-law-sharpness
soundness_flags.one_line: The condition only restricts the potential-outcome trend at the realized baseline dose X, whereas the cited source's parallel-trends assumption applies to every dose d; it must be retagged novel and cannot support a claim of extending the source theorem without a source-compatible reconstruction.

soundness_flags.label: prop:marginal-gap and prop:continuous-hole-witness
soundness_flags.one_line: The displayed affine schedules depend on Z through 1/Z, so the assertion that they satisfy the source paper's all-dose parallel-trends assumptions is not coherent with the proposal's weaker baseline-only parallel-trends class.

soundness_flags.label: prop:nested-conditional-support
soundness_flags.one_line: The conditional-support inclusion is quantified over every delta>0 although X|M_delta=1 is undefined when P(M_delta=1)=0; quantify only over nonempty mover events or use the conditional-probability formulation.

soundness_flags.label: thm:honest-outer-ci
soundness_flags.one_line: Conditional on the affirmative Question 12 inclusion event, coverage is a direct consequence of the outer-program definition, so this should be a corollary rather than a separate root theorem target.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:2402.05432v1 public manuscript; the AEA Papers and Proceedings landing page confirms the cited 2024 publication but its full text was inaccessible
source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 2 and 6: Assumptions 2 and 4; Appendix proof of Theorem 1, displays (3)--(5)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Assumption 4 is marginal, P(|Delta D|<=eta)>0, while the Appendix conditions on D1 and writes P(|Delta D|<=eta|D1)>0; Assumption 2 is an all-dose parallel-trends condition, not merely the realized-baseline restriction used in the core.

The no-stayer support condition is Supp(D1|M_delta=1) subset Supp(D1|M_delta=0), equivalently P(M_delta=1|D1)<1 almost surely, and Theorem 3 identifies its stated quasi-stayer-limit target under Assumptions 1--2.
Theorem 4 gives sharp WAS bounds in Design 1 under the bounded conditional-average-slope restriction, with endpoint expressions based on the common period-one zero baseline design.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Choose one comparison lane: either impose the source's all-dose parallel-trends condition and rebuild the sharp completion/witness inside it, or retag baseline-only parallel trends as a new assumption and withdraw the claim that the construction refutes or strictly repairs the source theorem.
State conditional quasi-stayer support as P(M_delta=1|X)<1 almost surely for every delta with a nonempty mover event, then prove the nesting reduction using that well-defined condition.

Move the conditional coverage implication to a corollary of a sharpened band-to-program theorem, whose root target should state the exact simultaneous event and endpoint inclusion needed for coverage.

recommended_next_step: Continue revision on the source-comparison angle: repair the parallel-trends mismatch before advancing the otherwise field-grade sharp-completion kernel.
